title: An hour-long duo jam with Roy Eldridge
summary: Eldridge sat in with Tatum, and one night he and Stewart jammed as a duo for an hour in an uptown after-hours place.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now, did you work much with Roy Eldridge on 52nd Street during those years?

Not very much. He used to come in also and sit in with Art Tatum and myself and, of course, I got into quite a few sessions in after-hour places uptown, you know, especially Roy and myself one night, if I remember, got into -- just the two of us -- and we got into this session somewhat like a Don Byas and Slam Stewart affair, you know, and we just blew and blew for up to an hour, just the two of us.
And the cats they were, the musicians
in the place, but they just gave the show to us and that was quite a scene, you know, and it was enjoyable, you know, just the two of us. Roy can really blow and even today, he's still blowing good.
